If anyone tries to sneak in… you can send them straight down a trapdoor. Meanwhile, you’ll have to weigh and tag luggage correctly; if it exceeds the limit, decide which items to leave behind. But here’s the twist: the airport n…

title: Paralyzed Penguins
shortDescription: Paralyzed penguins is a roguelite shooter game where you can only move by shooting. Explore randomly generated rooms with hundreds of possible layout fighting enemies and bosses along the way. You can unlock new characters and upgrades to make it farther in your next run.
aboutTheGame: Paralyzed penguins is a roguelite shooter game where you can only move by shooting. You explore randomly generated rooms and fight bosses climbing the tower collecting upgrades as you go. You can unlock new characters and upgrades over playthroughs.

title: One Fleet
shortDescription: A war fought in pencil on a single sheet of paper. Your fleets are marks drawn by your Hand. Command sketched ships in real-time battles, alone across a conquest campaign, or online with friends.
aboutTheGame: Draw your fleet. Take it to war. ONE FLEET is a real-time space-battle game fought in pencil on paper. Graphite hulls sketched on a desk, color only where the shooting starts. You draw your first ship, and from that line you fight your way across the Page. Bring up to three friends into a standoff or a wave run and you command one fleet between you, four hands on the same sheet, disagreeing about it in real time. Five ways to fight Conquest. A solo campaign across a galaxy. Gather graphite, build an armada, and push outward node by node, burying rivals in the strata of the ones who held those…

title: Family Time
shortDescription: Build a family with thousands of wolf children with your own wolf partner!
aboutTheGame: You're a Father Now All of a sudden you have to take care of dozens of wolf children! Every night their number grows! Fail to do so and your partner, the Wolf Mama, will kill you! How many can you sustain? Shelter Your Family! Build houses for them, or command them to build them for you! Feed your Family! Farm food for them or go out hunting with them! Pamper your Family! Keep them snug in their own beds to not anger the Wolf Mama! Can you support 10 children? 100? 1000? 10,000? Find out.

title: Mortality... Please
shortDescription: Penelope falls for a nineteen-year-old who has not aged in over a century. His face survives in yearbooks, VHS tapes, and dead forum pages. Then an elderly woman arrives with a photograph of herself beside him. A short psychological horror VN about eternal youth and the people it leaves behind.
aboutTheGame: Kyte has been nineteen for more than a century. In Mortality... Please , a short (~30 minute) psychological horror visual novel, you follow Penelope, a university student who falls for a hoodie-wearing boy seemingly untouched by adulthood, career panic, or the pressure to become somebody. During an ordinary history seminar, Kyte corrects the lecturer. He remembers the smell of a burned building, the name of someone missing from the official record, and an argument that happened away from every camera. He speaks like a witness. Osiris searches the campus archive and finds Kyte's unchanged face…

title: NULL VECTOR
tags: オンライン協力プレイ
shortDescription: ネオン幾何学で描かれるサバイバル・タワーディフェンス。中央のコアを守りながらプレイヤーを直接操作し、移動、照準、射撃、アクティブスキルを駆使。防衛施設を建築し、研究と敵能力モジュールでビルドを強化しよう。変化するボスを倒してエンドレスモードを解放するか、最大4人のオンライン協力で独立した30ウェーブの防衛戦に挑め。
aboutTheGame: NULL VECTORは、ネオン幾何学で描かれるトップダウン型サバイバル・タワーディフェンスです。中央のコアを守りながら、オペレーターユニットを直接操作し、移動、照準、射撃、アクティブスキルを駆使して敵の突破を阻止します。 防衛網を構築 コア、プレイヤー、システムを研究し、準備フェーズで防衛施設を配置。武器、アクティブスキル、パッシブ強化を戦況に合わせて組み替えます。敵はシールド、回復、ダッシュ、分裂、遠距離攻撃など複数の能力を同時に持つことがあります。 能力モジュールを収集 特殊能力を持つ敵を倒すと、対応するモジュールを獲得できることがあります。限られたスロットに移動、弾薬、防御、制御、資源系の効果を組み合わせ、自分だけのビルドを作成。入手済みモジュールはオペレーターに永久保存されます。 キャンペーンとエンドレス防衛 全15ウェーブのソロキャンペーンで、第10ウェーブの特殊ボスと第15ウェーブの最終ボスに挑戦。クリア後はエンドレスモードが解放され、敵は際限なく強化され、ランダムな能力を持ち、10ウェーブごとにボスが出現します。 最大4人のオンライン協力 最大4人でコアを共同防衛。マルチプレイは独立した30ウェーブ進行、共有建築コスト、戦利品プールと終了時の分配を採用し、敵とボスの数は参加人数に応じて増加します。

title: After School Sparkles: Complete Edition
shortDescription: ※日本語には対応していません。高校を舞台にした学園恋愛ビジュアルノベル。4つの物語で出会う少女たちと放課後を過ごし関係性を築いていく。部活で汗を流し、生徒会の選挙戦に奔走し、舞台の稽古に明け暮れて、オカルトな噂に振り回される。全15話の物語が4作品、ヒロインは12人。

shortDescription: Elastic Rabbit is a fast-paced indie physics brawler where rubbery movement meets explosive combat! Sling across a hand-drawn world, dodge mines, and team up with friends to protect the safe in high-octane, beat-synced mayhem.

Co-Op "Protect the Carrots": Team up with friends to guard the central carrots against waves of incoming hazards, bombs,…

title: AVXRPG
shortDescription: A 2D action RPG of short expeditions from a home town: fight, gather, complete stage quests, and forge your way forward.
aboutTheGame: A 2D action RPG of short expeditions from each stage’s town: fight, gather, complete its quests, and forge your way forward. Every stage puts a town under your feet and something dangerous outside it. You don’t live there. You kit up, pick a Scout, a Mission, or an Assault, and you go. Out there the fighting is close and simple. You move, you swing, you dash and you dodge. Between fights you collect wood, stone, and berries, because the next piece of gear is made from what you drag home, not from a level-up screen. Each stage wants its quests done. Finish them and the next stage opens: a diffe…

title: Slot Heroes
shortDescription: デスクトップオーバーレイで楽しめる、カジュアルな放置型ディフェンスゲーム。日常の合間に気軽に楽しみながら、次々と押し寄せるモンスターやボスを撃退しよう。 英雄たちを仲間にして強化し、無限に押し寄せるモンスターやボスから守り抜こう。
aboutTheGame: Slot Heroesへようこそ！ 絶えず強くなり続けるモンスター軍団が、あなたの村へ押し寄せてきます。 難易度が上がり続ける戦いの中で、戦略的な配置と強化を駆使して村を守り抜きましょう。 それぞれ異なる能力を持つ強力なボスたちも、あなたを待ち受けています。 新たな英雄を仲間にして、自分だけのパーティを完成させよう。 さまざまなクラスの英雄たちを集め、育てていきましょう。 レアからエピック、レジェンダリーまで、新たな英雄を手に入れるたびに戦略の幅が広がります。 英雄たちのアクティブスキルとパッシブスキルを組み合わせて、自分だけの最強パーティを作り上げましょう。 オーバーレイ機能で、戦いを任せよう。 あなたが他の作業をしている間も、戦闘は止まりません。 オーバーレイ機能を使えば、画面の片隅でパーティが戦い続ける姿を楽しめます。 その場を離れている間もゴールドは貯まり続け、戻ってきたときには、さらに強くなった英雄たちがあなたを迎えてくれます。 実力を競い合おう。 PvE攻略に慣れてきたら、他のプレイヤーと実力を競いましょう。 非同期PvPとリアルタイムPvP、2つのモードであなたのスロット戦略を試すことができます。

title: 杠杆地产开发商
shortDescription: Become an ambitious, ruthless real estate tycoon. Borrow, mortgage, or go public to build your empire with other people’s money. Raise funds, buy land, build, and sell—all with simple clicks—and watch your capital snowball at incredible speed.

Leverage Your Way to Faster Expansion Time is the most valuable resource. A great steward of capital must do everything possible to maximize…

title: Dojo of a Thousand Lives
shortDescription: Dojo of a Thousand Lives is an incremental game where you train a lineage of fighters guided by Kano. Face powerful bosses, develop your talent tree, and pass on your legacy. Each life brings you closer to absolute mastery. How far will your lineage go?
aboutTheGame: In Dojo of a Thousand Lives , a single lifetime will not be enough to achieve mastery. Guided by Kano, an ancient master as mysterious as he is kind, you lead a lineage of fighters against increasingly powerful opponents. Train, improve your abilities, and face formidable bosses as you push your fighter’s limits further with every battle. But every life eventually reaches its limits. When the time comes, pass the experience you have gained on to a new generation. Your journey begins again, but your legacy remains: develop an extensive tree of permanent talents, master ancient techniques, and g…

title: Zombie X
shortDescription: Endless arcade shooter. Survive shifting zombie arenas, chain kills, swap weapons, and beat your high score
aboutTheGame: Zombie X is an endless arcade shooter. There is no campaign to finish and no final level. You drop into the arena, stay alive, and push the score as high as it will go. The run gets harder the longer it lasts. Zombies pack tighter. The pace climbs. One mistake ends the attempt — then you jump back in and try to beat the number. Points come from clean hits, kill streaks, and surviving each new stretch of the fight. Stay in rhythm and the score climbs faster. Weapons change how a run feels. A pistol holds range. A shotgun clears the circle around you. A rifle pins a wave. Heavy guns rip through…

title: Splashback
shortDescription: Splashback is a fast-paced arcade watercraft racing game where you carve through waves, battle AI opponents, master challenging courses, and chase the perfect racing line.
aboutTheGame: Splashback is a fast-paced arcade watercraft racing game built around speed, responsive handling, big waves, and close competition.
